paragraph: Today’s Granville composite reading sits at a cautious 60 out of 100, heavily constrained by an active divergence warning where the S&P 500 is rising while the equal-weight RSP to cap-weighted SPY breadth ratio slips by 0.10 percent. Despite this structural leadership friction, underlying internals flash aggressive strength through bellwether semiconductors surging 5.01 percent against the broader market and high-beta risk appetite leaping 4.23 percent over low-volatility counterparts. Macro conditions provide a supportive backdrop with the VIX resting calmly at 19.92 alongside a stable contango term structure, while tightening high-yield credit spreads at 3.42 percent and a weakening U.S. dollar at $28.97 ease systemic stress. Defensive rotation also hints at underlying accumulation as the XLP to XLY ratio drops 1.96 percent, reinforcing a constructive environment for cyclical participation. Expect the session to maintain a cautiously bullish directional lean as aggressive sector leadership outweighs headline breadth warnings.
